provenance.tolerance_method: Conservative engineering allowances (12–20 degrees, 0.2–0.3 torso lengths); not fitted or coach-approved technique boundaries.
notes: References are contiguous observed geometry from source-labelled demonstrations of one athlete.
Motion endpoints are automatic and unreviewed. Partial intervals never establish a completed repetition.
Views and handedness must match exactly; source views are not synchronized.
Root travel uses initial image-plane torso-height scaling; it is not calibrated court distance or ball contact.
Pose file digests are rechecked; media digests are inherited from the verified capture manifest.

Five visually confirmed inverted encoded sources are rotated180 degrees using a SHA-bound review; anatomical IDs and original files remain unchanged. Residual inverted pose observations break the trajectory; they are never flipped frame by frame.
